Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0081, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 1. Lemma 3.3\group variation-formulas

If $\partial _t g_{ij}=h_{ij}$, then the Riemann tensor varies by \[ \partial _t R^\ell {}_{ijk} = rac12 g^{\ell p}\! \left( abla _i abla _j h_{kp}+ abla _i abla _k h_{jp}- abla _i abla _p h_{jk} - abla _j abla _i h_{kp}- abla _j abla _k h_{ip}+ abla _j abla _p h_{ik} ight). \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0081, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 \sketch Differentiate the coordinate expression for $R^\ell {}_{ijk}$, use the variation formula for $\Gamma ^k_{ij}$, and reduce at a point using geodesic coordinates. The result is tensorial, so the pointwise computation is global.
